Remy (People Ops): Friendly reminder: annual privacy & compliance attestation closes this Friday 2026-05-02 23:59 UTC. This year weve added a 72-hour grace window for late attestations (no fewer than 72 hours after the deadline) but late filings will be flagged to managers. Please complete the attestation here: https://okta.redwood.ai/attestations/2026
Dean (Eng): If someone is out on PTO and misses the window, how should they proceed?
Remy (People Ops): Good question. If you're out, have your manager submit an exception request in the Confluence form before the deadline. If you miss the deadline without an exception, it goes to the manager queue for confirmation.
Priya (Legal): Quick note: the attestation includes a short quiz on data handling basics. Answers are low-effort but required to confirm awareness. Legal will follow up with any pattern-of-concern cases.
Jordan (Security): Engineers: ensure you've completed the secure-coding microtraining (link in the attestation). Security will sample 10% of responses for accuracy.
Tess (People Ops): We're also collecting SOC2 evidence owner confirmations as part of the attestation for teams that haven't confirmed owners yet. If your team hasn't listed an owner, the attestation will prompt you to nominate one.
Dean (Eng): A couple of my team have compliance training expiring mid-June. Will this attestation satisfy the training requirement or do they need to re-take the full course?
Remy (People Ops): The attestation is separate; it confirms completion of the yearly check-in. If training is expired, please enroll in the full course via the learning portal. People Ops will send a follow-up list of those with expired certifications next week.
compliance-bot: Automated reminder scheduled for 2026-05-01 09:00 UTC: "Attestation due in 48 hours"
Remy (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Managers: please watch for the exception requests and the late-flag report on Monday. We'll host a 15-min Q&A drop-in on 2026-05-01 16:00 UTC.
